caveats: Synthetic evaluation fixture based on public search results and opened public content pages; no private browser history, accounts, or actual user activity were accessed.
All content-page evidence has search_query:null. Relative ages and repeat-session counts are invented solely to exercise retrieval behavior.
Spanish recall queries and expected IDs are hand-curated labels, not measured algorithm outputs or validated human judgments. Pages and titles may change.
